name: 104 Corporation
summary: 104 Corporation engages in the information technology, general advertising, employment, and human resource consultancy services in Taiwan and internationally. It offers online recruitment, advertising, learning, HR Salary management system, HR assessment, and executive search services. The company provides career placement and career service, educational services for career development, employer branding and customized integrated recruitment, talent acquisition and recruitment, personal career analysis and career counseling, executive and key talent pool, and platform for seniors, as well as HR system tools and solutions.
